DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy secondary to perinatal asphyxia and chorioamnionitis.

The combination of extreme prematurity (31 weeks), low birth weight, chorioamnionitis, poor Apgar scores, and the onset of seizures and lethargy at day 3 is highly suggestive of HIE.
